This is a good size of product for the price, I just wish the ingredients had more good oils that would keep my hair moisturized for days without build up but overall I am satisfied with my results. I really like this product.  It keeps my curls defined without looking wet or crunchy.  You need very little product.  At first I used about the size of a quarter for my short hair & it weighed my curls down.  I have learned a dime size is perfect for me.  The difference I have found with this product compared to similar ones is even when I'm out in the wind my curls remain looking soft & not frizz. Update, I've noticed that my hair gets much more frizzy while I sleep & my natural curls are flat

I am Hispanic so my my hair is all over the place a little bit straight a lot wavy and some curls. I am going to keep buying this product for two reasons 1) zero white residue which is embarrassing and tacky 2) after I worked the product into my hair I was amazed I had NO need to wash my hands ( I washed anyway force of habit)  This product leaves your hair super soft super bouncy and it doesnt give you that helmet head look

reviews.t: I love it! It left my hair soft and with ...
reviews.x: I love it!  It left my hair soft and with beautiful curls, on wet or dry hair.  I am 4-b.

I purchased this curl cream for my four year old's hair. She has ringlets naturally, but they often get tangled and fuzzy as the day progresses. Since receiving this I have been wetting with water/conditioner in the morning (same as always), then applying a generous amount of the cream and brushing her curls with my fingers. I then just let her hair air dry. The attached photo is today after ballet class and riding in her car seat. Curls have remained nice and calm. Very happy with the product a

reviews.t: This really works for my hair!
reviews.x: I hesitate to say this, lest I jinx myself, but I feel as if I have finally found a curl cream that really works well on my hair. The search for a good cream, when you're an African American woman, can be a daunting one. Many times, you can have different grades of hair on one head. This cream makes my hair soft, but still controlled. It has no discernible smell and a nice consistency.

I am accustomed to using many Redkin products and none of then have made my hair feel and look like it has with Bouncy Curls!

When I retired a couple of years ago, I decided (with urging of my daughter-in-law) to stop trying to manage it into a "professional" style and embrace my natural hair and curls.  I still wanted to minimze frizz though.  Bouncy Curl helps control the frizz without leaving my hair stiff if I use a minim

reviews.t: Awesome product just remember if your like to blow dry ...

Really love ❤ it. Not thrilled about the coconut smell but really hydrates and tames my naturally curly very long hair. My hair has been shedding and super thick since after chemo regrowth. Now, it's so long healthy and manageable.

But this product doesn't do that, its just sits on my hair, it's not moisturizing for my hair. It actually makes it dry after a couple of minutes. I will end up giving it to my sister, maybe it will work for her.

reviews.t: This is the best product I've found

My hair has a gentle natural curl, and this product definitely enhances the look. I could do with a little less coconut smell, but overall it's a winner.

reviews.t: Curl activator creates bouncy curls but not gentle on fragile hair
reviews.x: I am a white woman with longish hair past my shoulders. On a good day it's like Shirley Temple. On a bad day it's like Pattie LaBelle circa 1985. It looks great when freshly shampooed, but shampoo destroys my hair, as does conditioner, as does the dozens of other products (including homemade) I have tried before finally settling on plain water rinse, as infrequently as possible (one a week in the winter), which leaves my hair a tangled mess and nary a curl in sight. So I tried using Bouncy Curl

The roots naturelle bouncy curls is a great product for just that. I ran it through my hair with my fingers and let it air dry. My curls were more defined and frizz free. I apply after I slighty towel dry (leave hair damp, if hair is soaking wet its as if you never applied the product)  and detangle my hair and start applying on the ends then run through my hair, air dry and its just gorgeous, thank you #reordering soon

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product moisturizes well and leaves hair soft, defined, and bouncy.
Many reviewers praise how well it controls frizz and defines curls without leaving hair crunchy or stiff.
Several reviewers mention the coconut scent, with some loving it and others finding it too strong or overdone.
A few reviewers report the product left their hair dry or frizzy and did not moisturize as advertised.
Some reviewers note that using too much product weighs curls down or leaves white residue.
